title: Private Upgrade Flight Controller and LTS Rollback Plan
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build a resilient, auditable "flight controller" service and supporting tooling to coordinate upgrades of Redwood Private clusters (VPC and on-prem). Scope includes: orchestrated schema and runtime migrations, LTS channel awareness, canary and staged rollouts with configurable gates, automated rollback behavior tied to SLO/health metrics, and special handling for air-gapped customers. The controller must produce deterministic upgrade manifests, run preflight validations, and emit rich audit events for customer and compliance use cases. This ticket covers the core orchestration engine, the migration runner contracts, and the rollout gate primitives; separate follow-ups will implement provider-specific agents (k8s operator, bare-metal runner) and UI surfaces in Console.
acceptance_criteria: Flight controller accepts a declarative upgrade manifest and produces an execution plan with explicit stages and gates
Controller can run a four-stage rollout: preflight -> canary -> gradual -> final, with per-stage timeouts and automatic pause/rollback hooks
Migration runner can sequence DB schema migrations and model artifact updates, with idempotency and resume semantics after controller restarts
LTS channel configuration available in manifest; controller prevents non-LTS mismatched upgrades unless explicit override provided
Air-gapped upgrade mode that supports offline artifact staging and checksum verification
Controller emits audit events (upgrade_start, stage_transition, validation_failure, rollback) and exposes them via logs and event webhook for Console ingestion
End-to-end integration test that runs a canary upgrade on a simulated cluster and triggers automatic rollback when injected latency/SLO breaches occur
tasks: Design: upgrade manifest schema (channels, gates, migrations, rollbacks, artifact references)
Implement: flight controller core (state machine, persistent execution state, event stream)
Implement: migration runner interface and idempotent migration primitives
Implement: health gate adapters (Prometheus SLO query, custom probe hooks)
Implement: air-gapped artifact verification and staging protocol
Add: audit event schema and webhook delivery mechanism
Add: integration test harness for canary + rollback scenarios
Docs: operator runbook and customer-facing upgrade checklist
Console: minimal API endpoint for kicking off a controller-managed upgrade (follow-up UX ticket)
